item.title: Building Culture in Remote Engineering Teams
item.description: When the world went remote in 2020, many thought it would be temporary. Four years later, remote work has become the norm for engineering teams. But building culture remotely? That’s still a challenge many teams struggle with. Over the past few years, we’ve helped dozens of engineering teams build thriving remote cultures. Here’s what actually works. The Culture Challenge Remote work solves many problems but creates new ones: Isolation: Engineers feeling disconnected from their team Communication gaps: Important context lost in translation Timezone friction: Half the team is always asleep Onboarding struggles: New hires taking months to feel integrated The traditional solution—more meetings—often makes things worse.
